evidence.planOrModel: Oral implies a Gemini / Antigravity weekly quota that is already exhausted, and attributes 2B tokens to one week of Gemini 3.8 Flash. Plan tier is not labeled on the crop.

evidence.oralText: Gemini 4 hydrogen just launched to replace Gemini 3.8 flash, but I couldn't test it because weekly quota is exhausted. Sharing stats for how many Gemini 3.8 flash tokens you get in 1 week (2 billions).
evidence.conflictsToKeep: 2.04B is the Antigravity provider total, not a Gemini 3.8 Flash model breakdown. 46.3% is share of 4.42B, not weekly quota %. The crop does not show the date filter (7d vs 30d vs all-time). No official quota % is visible. Do not treat 2.04B as a measured official weekly Flash pool, and do not 2.04B÷100%.
evidence.why: 截图被裁掉了时间窗，2.04B 是 Antigravity 合计不是 Gemini 3.8 Flash 周池，可见百分比是 token 占比。
